portrait_source.prompt:
Studio portrait against a black backdrop. Head and shoulders, the head centered in the upper half of the frame. One hard key light from the front, a little to the camera's left and a little above eye level, no fill: the far side of the face falls into shadow. 85 mm lens, eye level.
A 29-year-old West African woman, lean and long-necked. Very dark brown skin with a warm undertone and a soft natural sheen on the cheekbones and forehead. Natural hair cropped very close, about a centimeter long, following the round shape of the head; ears fully visible. Long oval face, very high sculpted cheekbones, a defined jaw, a broad nose, full wide lips in their natural deep color. No makeup, no jewelry. Composed and serious, mouth closed.
Wardrobe: a fine black merino crew-neck sweater, no logos.
Head turned three-quarters to her left (toward the right edge of the picture), so her right cheek, right temple and right ear face the camera; chin level, eyes open, looking the way her head is turned.
No glasses or sunglasses, nothing on or near the face, temples and ears clear of hands and objects.
Photograph, natural skin texture, no retouching. No text, no logos.
